title: espOS configuration
description: Every property is an NVS namespace; every nested property is a key in it. Values omitted from a PUT are left untouched; null resets a key to its default; secret values read back as "********" and that sentinel is ignored on write.

app.title: Example app

label.title: Label
label.description: Free-text name shown in the UI.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the example task.

interval_ms.title: Interval
interval_ms.description: How often the example task logs a heartbeat.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Demonstrates a secret: never read back over the API.

cal_table.title: Calibration table
cal_table.description: Opaque bytes, base64 over the API.

watch_path.title: Watch path
watch_path.description: A SignalK path or family (e.g. navigation.position, notifications.*) the example app subscribes to and logs. Empty = off.

app.description: Settings of the example application in main/.

httpd.title: HTTP server

port.title: TCP port
port.description: Port the HTTP server listens on.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Shared secret for the web UI and the REST API, sent as Authorization: Bearer or exchanged for a login cookie. Empty = no authentication, the API is open to anyone on the network. 8–64 characters; the Config page can generate one. Changing it logs every browser out.

session_ttl_s.title: Login session lifetime
session_ttl_s.description: How long a browser login (the espos_sid cookie) stays valid. Sessions live in RAM; a reboot ends them all.

httpd.description: Built-in web server serving the UI and the REST API.

ota.title: Firmware updates

manifest_url.title: Manifest URL
manifest_url.description: http(s) URL of a version manifest (docs/ota.md). Empty = manual updates from a URL only.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Which channel of the manifest to follow, e.g. stable or beta.

auto_check.title: Check automatically
auto_check.description: Fetch the manifest after boot and every check interval.

auto_install.title: Install automatically
auto_install.description: Install a newer build from the manifest as soon as it is found (device reboots). Off = only show it.

allow_insecure.title: Skip TLS certificate check
allow_insecure.description: Accept any https certificate (self-signed boat servers). Images are still signature-checked.

confirm_tmo_s.title: Rollback timeout
confirm_tmo_s.description: A freshly installed image must reach the network within this time, else the device rolls back to the previous firmware.

ota.description: Over-the-air updates: where to look for new firmware and how careful to be about a freshly installed image.

sk.title: SignalK server

discovery.title: Discover servers via mDNS
discovery.description: Browse _signalk-http._tcp on the local network. Off = only the manual server below. Setting a manual host also stops discovery: an explicit address means that address, so nothing keeps browsing.

server_self.title: Preferred server (self URN)
server_self.description: Vessel self URN of the discovered server to use, e.g. urn:mrn:signalk:uuid:… Empty = first discovered server with a master role.

server_pin.title: Stay on the chosen server
server_pin.description: Never re-elect a different server once one is in use. The device keeps waiting for it to come back instead of moving to another discovered server. Off = pick a new server if the current one stops answering.

server_host.title: Manual server host
server_host.description: Host name or IP when mDNS is blocked. Empty = use discovery. When set, this address is used exclusively and mDNS discovery stops.

tls.title: Use TLS (https/wss)
tls.description: Talk to the server over https and wss instead of http and ws. Requires a firmware built with ESPOS_SK_TLS; without it this setting is inert and the device logs that it is. The server certificate is validated against the bundled Mozilla roots, so a self-signed certificate will be refused.

description.title: Access request description
description.description: Shown to the admin approving the request. Empty = espOS <hostname>.

permissions.title: Requested permissions
permissions.description: readwrite is needed to publish deltas.

check_s.title: Token check interval
check_s.description: How often an approved token is verified against the server (detects revocation).

ws_enabled.title: Stream deltas
ws_enabled.description: Keep a WebSocket to the server open and send published values as deltas.

batch_ms.title: Delta batching window
batch_ms.description: Values published within this window go out as one delta message.

buffer_msgs.title: Offline buffer (messages)
buffer_msgs.description: Delta messages kept while the server is unreachable; oldest are dropped first.

drain_per_s.title: Backlog drain rate
drain_per_s.description: Buffered messages per second sent after a reconnect, so the server is not swamped.

health_s.title: Device health interval
health_s.description: Publish uptime, heap, RSSI, reconnects and reset reason this often. 0 = off.

stall_s.title: Stream stall before restart
stall_s.description: WiFi reports connected and the stream has worked since boot, yet it has been down this long: the device raises skLinkStalled as a fatal health condition and the health watchdog restarts it, because a wedged radio link is the one network fault a restart fixes. Generous on purpose so a server restart never reboots the device; raise it if your server takes longer to come back.

sk.description: Which SignalK server to talk to and how to obtain access. The device identity (clientId) and the token itself live in device state, not here.

wifi.title: WiFi

sta_enabled.title: Station enabled
sta_enabled.description: Connect to the configured networks. Off = radio idle (portal still available if enabled).

hostname.title: Hostname (moved to Network)
hostname.description: Superseded by net.hostname. A value here is moved there at the next boot and this key is cleared; set the hostname under Network.

psk0.title: Network 1 password
psk0.description: Empty for an open network, else 8..63 characters (WPA).

bssid0.title: Network 1 BSSID pin
bssid0.description: Optional aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff to pin one access point (no roaming).

ip_mode.title: Addressing
ip_mode.description: dhcp = take an address from the router. static = use the address below; applied before every connection, so a change takes effect at the next (re)connect or reboot.

ip.title: Static IP address
ip.description: IPv4 address for ip_mode = static. Invalid or empty falls back to DHCP with a warning in the log.

netmask.title: Static netmask
netmask.description: e.g. 255.255.255.0. Required with a static address.

gateway.title: Static gateway
gateway.description: Default router. Empty = none (the device then reaches its own subnet only).

dns0.title: Static DNS 1
dns0.description: Primary resolver with a static address. Empty = the gateway.

dns1.title: Static DNS 2
dns1.description: Backup resolver with a static address. Empty = none.

backoff_max_s.title: Reconnect backoff cap
backoff_max_s.description: Exponential backoff between rounds over all networks, 1 s doubling up to this cap, ±25 % jitter.

dhcp_tmo_s.title: DHCP timeout
dhcp_tmo_s.description: Associated but no IP after this long counts as a failed attempt.

connect_tmo_s.title: Connect timeout
connect_tmo_s.description: Safety net if the driver never reports a result.

fresh_assoc.title: Fresh association at boot
fresh_assoc.description: Drop the first WiFi association after each start once and join again, about 2 s per boot. Turn on when the device is unreachable for minutes after a power cut or crash: some access points (MikroTik RouterOS 7) keep the old connection and lose everything sent to the device until it times out.

portal_enabled.title: Provisioning access point
portal_enabled.description: Bring up the setup access point when no network is configured or nothing connects for a while.

portal_after_s.title: Portal after
portal_after_s.description: Seconds without a connection before the access point comes up (0 networks configured: immediately).

portal_ssid.title: Access point SSID
portal_ssid.description: Empty = espOS-<last 4 hex of the device MAC>.

portal_psk.title: Access point password
portal_psk.description: Empty = open network. 8..63 characters for WPA2.

ps_mode.title: Power save
ps_mode.description: WiFi modem power save. 'none' keeps latency lowest.

wifi.description: Station networks in priority order (slot 0 first), addressing, reconnect policy and the provisioning access point.
